segment_title: THE GIFT CARD SCAM HIDING IN PLAIN SIGHT AT THE STORE RACK
script_text: CRIMINALS ARE HITTING THE GIFT CARD DISPLAY BEFORE YOU EVER GET THERE. / THEY PEEL BACK THE PIN STICKER ON THE BACK OF THE CARD... / WRITE DOWN THE NUMBER AND THE PIN... / THEN STICK IT BACK DOWN SO IT LOOKS UNTOUCHED. / YOU BUY IT, LOAD IT WITH MONEY AT THE REGISTER... / AND THE SCAMMER IS ALREADY DRAINING IT BEFORE YOU GET HOME. / THE FTC HAS BEEN WARNING ABOUT THIS FOR YEARS AND IT STILL WORKS. / WATCH HIM SHOW YOU HOW TO CHECK A CARD BEFORE YOU BUY IT.
visual_spec: handheld vertical, person at a retail gift card rack holding a card to camera, peeling back the PIN sticker to show it has been tampered with
